time: raw value of timer channel 9 (0x98900074): a 30-bit counter that counts down, one step per microsecond
note: The dictionary of the next debug build. tables, names and doc are notes: they are not part of the build id. The dictionary of a flashed build is kept as events-<build id>.json (docs/logging.md)

gui_state.0x5B02: ShootingInterval: sequence runs, waits for a frame

cbs.155: live view stops for a menu, step 2 (inferred)
cbs.167: live view stops for a menu, step 1 (inferred)

art.69: Soft Focus (stock code; the menu entry gives 102)
art.73: Pin Hole I (stock code; the menu entry gives 145)
art.86: Diorama (stock code; the menu entry gives 167)
art.102: Soft Focus entry (stock: Pop Art II)
art.145: Pin Hole entry (stock: Pale&Light Color II)
art.163: Key Line I (also the line job of peaking)

heap_mode.0: 0 (for 3 ms, when an effect filter ends)

fw_error.0x19000C03: DMA copy 0x7E426045: the destination address is a cached one (stock, every start)
fw_error.0x19000C02: DMA copy 0x7E426045: the source address is a cached one (stock, every start)

address.0x7E47D7C4: prm CPRAM image in the firmware

events.name: boot
events.doc: Usr0 starts (boot task). ring_found = how often the boot hook found a ring in RAM. The ring is also started by a record that is put before the boot task runs. On the camera the firmware records errors at 19 ms, so a cold start gives 1, and a restart that kept the RAM gives 2 or more. Without such records (emulator) a cold start gives 0. poweron is read before the firmware sets it (0x7E45D1F3, called later in Usr0): always 0

events.name: flush
events.doc: The flush task starts. previous = result of the flush before this one (write_failed: fwrite gave less than a block three times; not_saved: the file did not keep the blocks, their records are written again; no_file: no card, or the file cannot be opened or its size cannot be read)

events.name: fw_error
events.doc: The firmware's error recorder 0x7E426D4B was called

events.name: fw_error_args
events.doc: Follows fw_error: the number of extra arguments and the first one (not valid when count is 0)

events.name: gui_state
events.doc: The GUI sub-application state changed (0x57xx menu, 0x3xxx playback, 0x2xxx power off and sleep, 0x5xxx shooting)

events.name: pk_mf_start
events.doc: MF Assist starts (entryMfAssistOn). R is 1 already. C is still the colour of the MF Assist run before (0 after power-on): the mov task reads setting 458 into C in the next frame, in the call that sets L (see pk_latch)

events.name: pk_mf_end
events.doc: MF Assist ends (entryMfAssistOff). It also runs once at each start of the camera

events.name: pk_latch
events.doc: The peaking bytes changed, seen at the live-view expose setter: L latch, R request, L2 latch of the last update, C value of setting 458 (1 Off, 3 White, 2 Red, 4 Yellow, 5 Blue)

events.name: pk_heap_mode
events.doc: The image-work heap mode setter 0x7E578C60 was called with a new mode. Every change is logged, not only those of peaking. caller is always 0x7E4C935E: the one stock call of the setter is replaced by the peaking code, which calls it from there

events.name: pk_pass9
events.doc: Key Line pass 9 (the colour pass of peaking). The first 3 passes after each MF Assist start. gain is usGain2: 512 for White, 0 for a colour (the colour loop wrote the lines). first_pixel is byte 1 of the line image

events.name: pk_stats
events.doc: One record per 8 runs of Key Line pass 9 (the Key Line art filter, White peaking and colour peaking). loop_us: the microseconds from before the peaking hook of the pass to after it, summed over these 8 passes. For a colour that is the colour loop; for White and Key Line it is a few microseconds. gain: usGain2 of the last pass. The time between two records of one run is 8 frame periods. Only in the build debug-log-peaking-fast (spec log-peaking-time)

events.name: pk_guard
events.doc: The save guard of peaking holds the lines back (spec peaking-save-guard: the latch byte L is 2): the heap is not in mode 1 and the pool of the heap modes 0 and 2 is in use, by a photo that is being developed and saved. One record per hold, written at the first focus-ring event after the hold began (the probe is in the handler of that event); a hold with no ring event gives no record, pk_latch shows every hold (L = 2) and its end (L = 1: the lines start). units: the pool's units in use (not a block count; 0 = free)

events.name: art_sixaxis
events.doc: Six-axis stage dispatch 0x7E56D2BF: a new art code, or the first pass after a shooting callback. The gate is one for both CPUs: when the two CPUs run jobs with different codes, each pass is logged

events.name: lv_adjust
events.doc: api_adj_Set_Slope_Adjust: mode 1 Adjust, 2 Reset, 0 factory

events.name: lv_values
events.doc: The accelerometer driver reloads its tables (start-up, after Adjust and Reset): entry 0 of the working set (landscape). x, y, z: 1000 = 1 g. temp: the temperature reading that was stored with the entry

events.name: iv_start
events.doc: OlyHfwOpeShoot::startIntervalShooting returns. The GUI calls it each time it shows the interval standby screen (state 0x5B00): after a menu, and after a half-press is released. It arms the mode. It is not the start of a sequence: that is shoot_cbs 259

events.name: iv_frame
events.doc: recordingDone_interval: frame n of this sequence is recorded and another frame follows; the timer for the next frame starts here. The last frame of a sequence does not come here (0x7EA8C4F7), so a sequence of N frames gives N - 1 records

events.name: iv_end
events.doc: OlyHfwOpeShoot::endIntervalShooting returns: the mode is disarmed (a menu opens, or a sequence is complete). iv_frames = iv_frame records since the last iv_start: the frames of the sequence less 1, or 0 when no sequence ran

events.name: iv_state_set
events.doc: setIntervalShootingState. Bits as seen on the camera: 1 armed, 2 shutter button pressed in standby, 4 the timer before a frame runs

events.name: iv_state_clear
events.doc: clearIntervalShootingState. bits 0xFFFFFFFF clears all

events.name: film_stage
events.doc: Colour-matrix stage 0x7E56C68B: a new art code (byte +79 of the job parameters), or the first pass after a shooting callback. Code 3 is a job without an art filter (the plain picture of peaking, and two jobs of each capture). flags: the job flags (+20); with bit 16 or 17 the stage takes code 3. The gate is one for both CPUs (see art_sixaxis)

events.name: film_matrix
events.doc: The art matrix that is applied (0x7E56C764). stack = address of the result matrix in the stack frame of the stage: it tells the tasks apart (one value for live view on CPU 1, two for stills on CPU 0)

events.name: film_curve
events.doc: Tone-curve selector dispatch 0x7E56E860: the handler chooses the curve set

events.name: shoot_cbs
events.doc: Shooting callback 0x7E995A0B, sent by the dispatcher 0x7E995C0B (CBS_START_SHOOTING_PICTURE, CBS_END_INTERVAL_SHOOTING ...). It also arms the art and film probes for one record each

events.name: card_read
events.doc: The card-read probe at the first flush of a session: fileif_fopen(C:\EPM2LOOK.BIN, "r"), fileif_fread of 16 bytes (0x7E5C536F), fileif_fclose. bytes = -1: the file did not open (first4 is then not the file's). first4: bytes 0-3 of the file as a little-endian word

events.name: card_look
events.doc: Probe 2: a file that starts with LOOK (26 bytes or more) has its bytes 8-25 written into the art matrix of codes 71 and 80 (Pro 400H, 0x7ECB0988, read by the colour stage on CPU 1). written = values written (9, or 0: not a look file); first2 = values 0 and 1 of the table read back from RAM (low half value 0, high half value 1)

events.name: card_rec
events.doc: The probe harness: one record of an LKP1 card file. status 0 = written (cached address and uncached alias), 1 = outside every allowed table of the Pro 400H slot, not written

events.name: card_done
events.doc: The probe harness has finished the file: records written, and the file's flags (bit 0: the look stages were made to recompute)

events.name: card_keep
events.doc: The persistence probe: a loaded look was stored as a record LKB1 in the EEROM bank's tail (0x603FC000) and the bank save API 0x7E680272 was called. result = its d0 (0 in the emulator); sum = the record's 16-bit sum

events.name: bank_tail
events.doc: At the first GUI state of a session: the number of nonzero words in the EEROM bank's unused tail 0x603F74B8-0x60404668 (0 = empty), and the first word at 0x603FC000 (0x31424B4C = a stored record LKB1)

events.name: bank_look
events.doc: At the first GUI state of a session: the stored look. status 0 = applied to the Pro 400H matrix, 1 = no record, 2 = bad length or sum; first2 = the table's values 0 and 1 read back from RAM (low half value 0)
